summary: Phase 4 (Advanced Assessment Engine + Psychometric & Behaviour Intelligence) — comprehensive backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright) testing. 18/18 Phase 4 backend tests pass; 18/18 Phase 1+2 regression pass. All 4 frontend pages (Assessments list/detail/take-attempt + Psychometrics 4 tabs) render correctly and integrate end-to-end with backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Institution IDs in seed data are UUID format (e.g. 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111), NOT slug-style 'isb-india' as agent_to_agent_context_note implied. Tests use UUIDs and pass. Future testing agents should refer to /app/memory/test_credentials.md or hit /api/institutions to discover IDs.

Assessment attempt option buttons do not have data-testid (e.g. answer-option-{n}). Adding data-testid='answer-option-0..3' on the MCQ choice buttons and 'submit-answer' on Submit would improve test stability. The flow itself works (8 options, correct highlighting, hint counter, progress).
Adaptive engine correctly hides correct_index from /start and /answer payloads (verified in test_start_and_first_item_no_correct_index).
wrong_streak rule fires correctly after 3 consecutive wrong answers (verified end-to-end via attempt → psychometric_events lookup).
